rationale: 2026-10-29 template, drawn up by the engineers' designer from mid-game stock parts. The upper stage (Skipper on five X200-16s, 40 t of propellant) climbs to orbit, meets the depot and pumps 16 t across, keeping enough to deorbit. The Mk1 pod docks nose first with a Clamp-O-Tron on four RV-105 RCS blocks and lands under a side-mounted Mk2-R parachute. Launch: Mainsail on four X200-32s with two Thumpers.
